These two petitions are filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against the petitioners in Crime No.162/2022 of Hagaribommanahalli Police Station for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 r/w Section 149 of I.P.C. and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. While Criminal Petition No.103637/2022 is filed by accused No.1, Criminal Petition No.103680/2022 is filed by accused No.2 to

For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as accused No.1 to 11.
4.
The accused have sought quashing of criminal proceedings, contending that since from the beginning respondent No.2 is living separately with accused No.1.
Accused No.2 to 11 are the parents, brother, sister and relatives of accused No.1.
The allegations that on 27.02.2022, accused No.1 to 11 came to the place of respondent No.2 and assaulted her is far from truth.
The very fact that she has chosen to file complaint on 16.09.2022 after lapse of about 7 months from the date of alleged incident goes to show that it is concocted and false story.

The parents, brother, sister,
sister-in-law and other relatives are all living separately.
Accused No.11 is the elderly member of the family.
He had only negotiated and tried to conciliate the dispute.

Accused No.1 has filed divorce petition against respondent No.2 - complainant.

sentences.text: 5 . On the other hand, learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant submitted that the marriage of accused No.1 and respondent No.2 - complainant was performed on 26.04.2020.
At the time of marriage, dowry in a sum of Rs.2,00,000/-, a gold chain and finger ring were given.
Everything went well till respondent No.2 - complainant gave birth to a daughter on 04.02.2021.
Since then accused No.1 and other accused started harassing and ill-treating her demanding to get additional dowry.
Infact, the elders of respondent No.2 - complainant intervened and conciliated and advised the accused persons.
5.1 On 14.12.2021, when the relatives of respondent No.2 - complainant tried to advise the accused persons, they abused them.
On her complaint, the Hagaribommanahalli (2018) 13 SCC 747 Police summoned accused No.1 and 2 to the police station and advised them.
After one month, harassment once again started.
Though accused No.1 set up a separate residence, he used to leave her alone and go to his parents' house and when questioned, he gave threat to her life.
Therefore, she started living in the house of her husband.
Recently accused No.1 was transferred to Davanagere and she came to know about his illegal relationship and when questioned, she was abused and assaulted.
On 27.12.2022, her parents visited her house.
All the accused persons picked up quarrel with her parents and assaulted them.
They were saved due to the intervention of the villagers.
She got treated her parents in the government hospital and went back to her parental home.
After waiting for some period, now she has chosen to file the complaint.
5.2 Learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant would further submit that based on the complaint, investigation is taken up.
At this stage of initial (2019) 4 SCC 615 investigation, the proceedings cannot be quashed.
The allegations against the accused persons are required to be proved at the full-fledged trial and prays to dismiss the petitions.

5.3 In support of his arguments, learned counsel for respondent No.2 - complainant has relied upon the endorsement given by the police on the earlier complaint filed by her stating that they have summoned accused No.1 and 2 and advised them.

6. Heard arguments and perused the record.

sentences.text: Accused No.1 is the husband, accused No.2 and 3 are the parents-in-law, accused No.4 to 6 are the brothers- in-law and sisters-in-law, accused No.8 is the uncle, accused No.9 is the aunt and accused No.10 is the uncle and accused No.11 is a distant relative of accused No.1.
The marriage of accused No.1 and respondent No.2 - complainant was solemnized on 26.04.2020.
According to the complaint averments, there were no allegation against the husband or other relatives till the birth of daughter.

Respondent No.2 - complainant has alleged that after she gave birth to a daughter, all the accused persons started harassing and ill- treating her and demanding additional dowry mainly on the ground that she has given birth to a daughter.
Admittedly except accused No.1 to 3, rest of the accused were not living with accused No.1 and respondent No.2 - complainant.

Infact according to the complaint averments, earlier she had given a complaint against accused No.1 and 2 and in that connection, respondent No.1 police summoned accused No.1 and 2 to the police station and advised them.

In the acknowledgment produced by respondent No.2 - complainant with regard to the earlier complaint, it is stated that the husband and mother-in-law were abusing her without any reason and they have been advised.
8. In the earlier complaint, there is no allegations of accused No.1 to 11 troubling or harassing respondent No.2 - complainant for giving birth to a daughter and that there was a demand of dowry.
Infact as per respondent No.2 - complainant herself, after she lodged the earlier complaint, her husband i.e. accused No.1 set up a separate residence.
Therefore, question of accused No.2 to 11 harassing or ill- treating her would not arise after she started living separately.

It appears only for the purpose of filing the present complaint, respondent No.2 - complainant has stated that after accused No.1 abused and assaulted her, she once again started staying in the matrimonial home along with her parents-in-law.
9. The allegations against accused No.2 to 11 are omni bus.
There are no specific allegations against them.
Having regard to the fact that accused No.1 has set up a separate residence, it appears there was no occasion for accused No.2 to 11 to harass and ill-treat respondent No.2 - complainant.
There is inordinate delay in filing the complaint.
Though according to the complainant, the incident took place on 27.02.2022.
However, she has chosen to file the complaint on 16.09.2022 after lapse of nearly 7 months.
It is pertinent to note that accused No.1 has filed M.C. petition on 12.09.2022 seeking divorce from respondent No.2 - complainant.
After coming to know about it, she has chosen to file the present complaint.

10. Having regard to the fact that there are no specific allegations against accused No.2 to 11 and after respondent No.2 - complainant came to know about the filing of divorce petition by accused No.2, she has chosen to file a complaint by roping in all the remaining accused goes to show that it is an arm twisting method applied by her to force the accused persons to come to terms with her.
Having regard to the fact there are no specific allegations against accused No.2 to 11, this Court is of the considered opinion that the criminal proceedings against them is liable to be quashed.
11. However, the complaint against accused No.1 cannot be quashed as there are specific allegations against him.
Taking into consideration these aspects, this Court is of the considered opinion that the petition filed by accused No.1 is liable to be dismissed.

However, the petition filed by accused No.2 to 11 deserves to be allowed and accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
